findings: 2026-11-06: drafted for Mathematics 12 Unit 2 (owner request): English and a teacher-style Roman Urdu lesson; the book's content in order with our clearly labelled teaching notes; worked examples step by step with reasons; results verified with sympy.
Book correction: In Proof (2) the equation \cot y = x is labelled (2), but the next line says 'We differentiate equation (1)'. It should say 'We differentiate equation (2)' (the equation \cot y = x).

Book correction: After writing \tan y correctly, the book repeats it with wrong intervals: x \in (1, -1) and x \in (-\infty, 1). The correct intervals (as in the line just before, and as the book's own reason says) are: \tan y = \begin{cases}\sqrt{x^{2} - 1}, & x \in (1, \infty) \\ -\sqrt{x^{2} - 1}, & x \in (-\infty, -1)\end{cases}

Book correction: Formula (5), that is (v), is already proved above as Proof (3). The formulas not yet proved are (ii), (iii) and (vi), so the Challenge most likely means: Prove formulae (2), (3) and (6).
